failure_summary: render_decision.requiredSet lists only you-key-line / opp-key-line / you-key-square and never obliges the better move to be named, so 2 of 3 served answers name only the played column 3 and leave the winning move (display column 2, decision-board solver score +1 vs -3 for the played column) unnamed — run 0 then dangles "that move is the toughest defense" with no antecedent and mislabels a forced win as a defense, echoing the prompt-supplied phrase "the deep parity resource resolves" as "your deep parity resource".
notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; run 2 is null (not scored) for those. This run has n=3 (not 5) rows for eval-4|D; A1/A2/A6/G7a/G7b copied verbatim from grade_mechanical.json for all 3. A6 run0/run1 fail (mechanical: prose never names column 2). A4 run0 fail: "that move is the toughest defense because it preserves your deep parity resource" is board-false — display column 2 scores +1 (forced win) on the decision board (movestring 333334, scr row -2/1/-3/-3/1/-3/-2) and fv.case is win_to_lose, so the better move wins outright rather than defends. A5 run0 fail: "your deep parity resource" is a render-terminology echo of the assembled prompt board-reason line "where the deep parity resource resolves — your line" (render-supplied → render_bug per the A5 triage rule); A5b is N/A here (player===1). A7b run0 fail: "that move" has no antecedent — the only column named in the served string is the played column 3, so the sentence reads as if column 3 were the defense. A7b run2 fail: "the key central reply" is a specific-sounding referent wrapped in no zone and named nowhere; no offered alias covers an opponent reply square (replyHistogram.afterPlayed=3 is a bare count). G2 run0 fail (guardrail half): L6 guardrail is "You gave up a win AND handed the opponent their own" and run 0 never conveys that a win was given up. G4/G5 verified: you-key-line c2r5,c3r5,c4r5,c5r5 is Green four-in-a-row completing at c5r5 on lostResource.finalMovestring 33333410111003110004224555552222566666644 (= render_decision.finalMovestring); opp-key-line c3r2,c4r2,c5r2,c6r2 is Gray four completing at c6r2 on its own truthBoard projectedDeepOpp; all four rendered tactic entries (c5r6 opp; c6r3 you, c6r4 opp, c6r5 you, c6r6 opp) reproduce exactly under visualize_board.sh. G6 pass: L6 with patternOnAfterBestBoard=null is the correct route for win_to_lose with both halves winning_line. G7 judgment half passes on all 3 runs: every emitted handle is line-words-on-line-handle / square-words-on-square-handle, annotationRepairs empty, guardDiagnostics clean. NOT charged: runs 1 and 2 omit the REQUIRED you-key-square handle — production would have retried on that, and the harness does not exercise the retry (OI-183), so it is an eval artifact, not a served defect.
